title: paged KV cache: adaptive block allocator reuse + locality-aware pinning optimizations
author: Maya Chen
commits: feat(paged-kv): add adaptive reuse heuristic to block allocator
perf(paged-kv): locality-aware pinning selection for GPU-local blocks

description: Context and motivation: The paged KV cache block allocator historically used a simple LRU-ish free list which led to suboptimal locality and churn for mixed workloads (short chat sessions + long inference runs). This PR introduces an adaptive reuse heuristic for the block allocator plus a locality-aware pinning policy to preference GPU-local blocks for sequential KV access patterns. The goal is to reduce p99 latency regressions caused by unnecessary block migrations and to increase throughput for continuous-batching workloads. Summary of changes: 1) Adaptive reuse heuristic in block_allocator: tracks per-block recent reuse score and prefers reassigning blocks with high reuse potential instead of evicting remote-local blocks; thresholds are configurable and learned heuristically from workload sampling. 2) Locality-aware pinning policy: pinning_policy chooses blocks based on device-locality scores (same GPU, same NUMA domain) and the expected access pattern; this reduces expensive cross-device transfers during KV cache hot paths. 3) TTL-aware eviction fallback: blocks with low reuse and expired TTL are reclaimed aggressively to bound memory pressure. 4) New deterministic unit tests and a microbenchmark harness that reproduces mixed chat + long-context workloads. 5) New CLI/config flags: --kv-adaptive-reuse-enable, --kv-pinning-locality-toggle, --kv-reuse-threshold. Benchmarks: Microbench on rtx-a100-8 node with continuous batching workload (batch size 16, seq len 1024) shows: - throughput +18% on average - p95 latency -9% - p99 latency -11% (reduction) - reduced GPU memcpy counts by ~27% These are measured with the included bench harness under integration/ci/paged_kv_cache_workload.yaml. Commits: feat(paged-kv): add adaptive reuse heuristic to block allocator; perf(paged-kv): locality-aware pinning selection for GPU-local blocks; test(paged-kv): add deterministic allocator unit tests; bench(paged-kv): microbench harness & results integration; docs(kv-cache): document new allocator heuristics and config flags. Files changed: See changed_files list above. Tests & CI: Unit tests added covering reuse thresholds and eviction order. A flaky integration test was observed on first CI run; it was rerun and passed. CI status is green. Review thread: reviewers requested deterministic tests, an opt-out flag for locality pinning, and a documentation update. All requests were addressed; reviewers approved and the PR was squash-merged. Migration/compatibility: The defaults preserve existing behavior unless the new flags are enabled. The feature is behind config flags so operators can roll out gradually. Release notes: This PR improves KV cache allocator reuse and pinning behavior which should reduce p99 latency and improve throughput for mixed workloads. Operators can enable adaptive reuse and locality pinning via the documented flags. Operational notes: We added telemetry counters (kv_allocator_reuses, kv_pinning_local_hits, kv_evictions_by_ttl) to the console dashboards to help tune thresholds. If issues are observed, disable --kv-pinning-locality-toggle to fall back to previous behavior. Merge outcome: merged into main via squash on 2024-11-12.
release_notes: Improved paged KV cache allocator and pinning policies: adaptive reuse heuristic + locality-aware pinning. Measured throughput up to +18% and p99 latency reduction up to 11% in continuous-batching workloads. Feature is behind flags and can be toggled at runtime.
